notes.title: Let the Chaos Rain
notes.content:
[p][b]Message from the Team[/b]

Even though it's been over a year, the Chaotic Hearts Team has not given up on our first project and has been working hard to implement what we can, despite life's hardships and the challenges of a shrinking team. With that said, we are almost finished with several future items to be implemented in our next update. Please stay vigilant and patient as we continue to do what we can when we can. Until then, destroy enemies and level up while exploring everything our newest version has in store for you as you let Chaos Rain down upon your enemies!!

[b]Change Log[/b] [/p][list][*][p] Enemies will now spawn continuously through all Maps.
[/p][/*][*][p] Safe Areas added for towns
[/p][/*][*][p] SW England now has repeatable Caves and Temples[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] All maps are completely designed and explorable
[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Works in Progress[/b] [/p][list][*][p] Adding repeatable spawners to all other maps for the caves and temples
[/p][/*][*][p] Changing enemies to align with the correct caves and temples
[/p][/*][*][p] Enemies will grow according to player stats and levels
[/p][/*][*][p] Quests and story finalization
[/p][/*][*][p] Finalizing upgradable weapons and armor
[/p][/*][*][p] Adding Bosses and Mini-Bosses to Caves and Temples[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] Adding mini bosses to the continuous spawn pool[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are aware that some save files are being transferred over from test runs, and we are working on a way for you to delete old saves as well. If you are new to the game, please go into the pause menu and restart the level after pressing continue in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We are sorry for such a long delay, but health and life  have made it difficult for our small team to progress at past speeds  [/p][p][/p][p]- KaozRain(Freddie) and the rest of the Chaotic Hearts Team[/p]

notes.title: Update on the lack of well...updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We know it has been a while since we made an update. without going into too much detail life has happened to many of us on the team and we went from a pretty decent size team to a handful of active members with spare free time. however, we are determined to make this game a success or at least a finalized product that can be enjoyed.

We took some time to sit down and discuss our next steps moving forward, considering the current state of things now. My original vision for Blades and Bullets doesn't seems do feasible in the time I was hoping, so I removed the projected deadline from end of this year to TBA while we work out these new alterations to the project. 

Our goal is still to deliver a Unique take on the events of WW2 as well as make an interesting game that doesn't follow the usual norms. We hope that those who have given our little game a shot and sees the potential remains patient with us. And to those who gave it a shot but didn't like what they experience, we as for patience as well and give the game another shot further down the line!

Johnny & Chaotic Heart Studios
